reviews.title: Like Brand New! Worked right out of the box
reviews.comment:
Like Brand New!
Worked right out of the box, I made sure
Before it came to have all the latest Asus Drivers ready
Downloaded them from Asus Support Page
I installed them and it has been working flawlessly
Glad I made the choice I did and buy this;
Asus 4060 Evo from this seller...
I also want to bring to light,
I also checked if it was what I bought the EVO not generic
With TechPowerUp GPU-Z
It was exactly what I bought and what was advertised
This is a Superstar Seller!
